issues.description: results.json check title (and REPORT Method item 3) says 'every 7-vertex triangulated closed surface is an orientable torus'. That is false as worded: a pentagonal bipyramid (sphere, chi 2) and a 7-vertex RP^2 (chi 1) exist (checked in xc_e0.py). The search only covered complexes with every pair in exactly two triangles, i.e. chi = 0 / K7 1-skeleton. The numbers (120, one orbit, |Aut| 42) are right.
issues.suggested_fix: Reword to 'every 7-vertex triangulated surface with chi = 0 (equivalently, every vertex pair in exactly two triangles) is the torus, unique up to relabelling (120 labelled copies)'.

issues.description: The AMENDED verdict on the closing tower sentence amends an interpretive judgment ('they don't stack into one clean tower'), not a fact. Every factual clause of that sentence holds as written: the Fano split belongs to the SU(3) rung, and the G2 turns that complete p6m swap the families (kappa, and hence PGL(2,7), swaps them too). The PGL(2,7) chain behind the amendment is verified correct.
issues.suggested_fix: Record it as 'facts CONFIRMED; wording AMENDED (interpretive)'. Keep the suggested chain G2 > SU(3):2 > PGL(2,7) > PSL(2,7) > F21 and state that the family split survives only up to PSL(2,7).

issues.description: The calibration table and results.json headlines mark seed-sourced items CALIBRATED (target source 'SEED §3', e.g. |<D,C>| = 21, x -> 4x, the Weyl turns). PLAN §1 reserves CALIBRATED for literature targets; reproducing a seed claim is CONFIRMED. The same facts already appear as CONFIRMED in seed_claims, so each is labelled twice.
issues.suggested_fix: Keep CALIBRATED only for rows with a literature target (LNR characters and quartic, ATLAS maximal subgroups, the p6m classification). Relabel the SEED §3 rows CONFIRMED.

issues.description: The maximal-subgroup target 'S4, S4, 7:3' is attributed to 'ATLAS p.3 (via SEED §9); LNR §5 [read]'. LNR §5 gives only the two isomorphism types ('two maximal subgroups, S4 ... and ... Z7 x| Z3'), not the two conjugacy classes of S4. The two-class statement rests on ATLAS, which was not read. The computation itself establishes the two classes, so no result is affected.
issues.suggested_fix: Cite as 'ATLAS (not read; via SEED §9); LNR §5 [read] for the isomorphism types'.

issues.description: In results.json seed_claims, background and literature-only statements ('SU(3) is the color group...', 'flavor model-builders have used both groups') are marked CONFIRMED although nothing was tested. The REPORT body separates them correctly as 'CONFIRMED with a cited part'.
issues.suggested_fix: Mark them 'CONFIRMED (cited, not computed)' or 'not tested' in results.json to match the report.

summary: Every headline number of E0 reproduces with independent code and different methods (81/81 cross-check checks). No blocking or major issue. Five minor wording, verdict-label and citation issues; the most concrete is an over-general check title about 7-vertex surfaces.
